query: Add mapping union operators to CaseInsensitiveDict: a | b, dict | a, and a |= b. All operands must be Mapping objects; reject other operands with TypeError. Return CaseInsensitiveDict for non-mutating union, preserve inputs, and preserve identity for in-place union. On keys equal ignoring case, the right-hand value and spelling win; retain existing key order and append new keys in right-hand order. Assume each operand has no internal case-insensitive duplicate keys. Keep existing header preparation behavior and document the new operations. This is an original exploratory feature, not an upstream issue.
